caption:
The hair dyes I do not recommend all have one thing in common! They all have PPD! But What is PPD? 👇 
🧪Paraphenylenediamine (PPD) is a common ingredient in many hair dyes which helps give rich, long-lasting color. 
❌PPD is also a strong allergen that can cause 
- severe skin reactions, 
- redness
- itching, swelling
- blistering

🤔Who should avoid PPD?
- sensitive skin
- eczema
- history of allergies 

✅Opt for PPD-free options which are widely available and much gentler on the scalp and skin.
